Leverage automation to monitor and orchestrate client environments.

Work with Kubernetes, Docker, and other container technologies.
Deploy all Azure PaaS services (API, AKS, AppService, FrontDoor, etc.).

2+ Years with Bachelor's degree.

Strong interpersonal skills and comfort initiating conversations to resolve issues or align on requirements.
Excellent troubleshooting skills.
Solid understanding of Azure public cloud platform.
Knowledge of software development life cycle.
Knowledge of programming languages and web-based technologies.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
Broad knowledge of cloud computing concepts and solutions.
Knowledge of infrastructure management within a cloud environment.
Knowledge of cloud delivery models.
Knowledge of web services, API Gateway, Elastic/Network Load Balancers.
Proficiency in modern software architecture using CI/CD, DevOps, Scalability, API first strategy, etc. Required.
